changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cat_oficina ( office_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, office_code VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) NOT NULL, office_name VARCHAR2(80 CHAR) NOT NULL, city VARCHAR2(60 CHAR), is_active CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_cat_oficina PRIMARY KEY (office_id), CONSTRAINT uk_cat_oficina_office_code UNIQUE (office_code), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_oficina_is_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N')) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Catalogo de salas con auditoria y clave ajena a la oficina
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cat_sala ( room_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, room_code VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, room_name VARCHAR2(80 CHAR) NOT NULL, office_id NUMBER NOT NULL, is_active CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, created_by NUMBER NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP(6), updated_by NUMBER, CONSTRAINT pk_cat_sala PRIMARY KEY (room_id), CONSTRAINT uk_cat_sala_room_code UNIQUE (room_code), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_sala_room_name_len CHECK (LENGTH(TRIM(room_name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 80), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_sala_is_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N')), CONSTRAINT fk_cat_sala_office_id FOREIGN KEY (office_id) REFERENCES cat_oficina (office_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: REQ-099: el nombre de sala es unico por oficina sin distinguir mayusculas
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_cat_sala_office_upper_name ON cat_sala (office_id, UPPER(room_name))
